steps: Activate Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron (M2): Special Summon 1 "Nerva the Power Patron of Creation" from your Extra Deck

select Nerva the Power Patron of Creation (M5)

Activate Medius the Pure (GY): Shuffle 1 monster from your hand or face-up field into the Deck, and if you do, Special Summon this card
Activate Theorealize Liberation (hand): Add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 monster from your Deck with 300 ATK/200 DEF
Add the card(s) to your hand
Activate Purification Power Patron (EMZ-R): Link Summon including this card as material
Medicurius the Power Patron of Illusions (Extra Deck)
Activate Griffoh (hand): Activate 1 of these effects
Set 1 card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual"
Activate Mind Shuffle (S1): activate this card
Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos (Deck)
Activate Light and Darkness Ritual (GY): Add both this card and 1 card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your GY to your hand
Activate Light and Darkness Ritual (hand): Ritual Summon 1 "Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness" from your hand
